data.narrative:
MightyFly is a Series A-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $10M to date. The broader peer universe comprises 8 private companies in the sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air; no public comparables exist in this space.

Given the early stage and heterogeneity of business models within drone and autonomous systems, traditional peer-median valuation is not applicable. No cohesive subset of same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with sufficient data density exists to anchor a reliable multiple-based valuation. Instead, the analysis relies on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $10M total raised as a proxy for current value. This implies a post-Series A valuation of $20M, reflecting typical investor expectations for capital deployment and early traction at this stage.

The triangulated range of $17M to $23M (median $20M) is supported by a single method and should be treated as indicative rather than definitive. Key uncertainties include the absence of disclosed financial metrics (revenue, unit economics, or deployment scale), which would normally anchor stage-appropriate valuation. The relative dispersion of drone/autonomous applications—from logistics to urban air mobility—means peer comparisons remain weak. Any refinement would require proprietary diligence on customer commitments, burn rate, and technical differentiation.
